description: Dataset for the StEAM energy system optimization model is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Oliver Linsel, Cornelia Klueter (Ruhr University Bochum). This is the corresponding dataset for the StEAM energy system optimization model. Please download the complete Data folder insert it into the top level of the StEAM_model folder on your machine. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
